faq.q: Can I make a video from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your photo, choose an AI actor and voice, and make a product video without filming. You can change the message later.

faq.q: How long does an AI video take to make?
faq.a: An AI video takes a few minutes to make. You can download it when generation finishes, and failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: How does the AI video generator work?
faq.a: Give it a product photo, link, or idea, then choose the style and voice. It makes a video with visuals and spoken words in a few minutes.

faq.q: Can I make videos for my online store?
faq.a: Yes. Make product demos, creator-style ads, or social videos from your photos and links. Use them on product pages or in campaigns.

faq.q: What voices can I use in an AI video?
faq.a: Choose a bright, calm, or deep voice that fits your product and customers. Preview several voices before posting.

faq.q: Which AI video generator is best for a small shop?
faq.a: Choose one that makes ads from your product photos, shows the credit cost, and lets you change the actor or words. AIVideosUGC does all three.

faq.q: Do I need to install software to make videos?
faq.a: No. Make and download your video in the browser. You can add music and captions in the same place.

faq.q: Can a product page link become a video?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product link to bring in its photos and details. Check the finished video against the product you sell.

faq.q: How do I make an AI product video?
faq.a: Upload a product photo, paste a product link, or describe your idea. Choose an actor and voice, then make a video in a few minutes.

faq.q: Can I use AI videos in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded videos can run in paid campaigns without a watermark. Check that every product claim is accurate before posting.

faq.q: Can I run an AI video on Facebook or Instagram?
faq.a: Yes. Download the video for Facebook or Instagram ads. Choose a square or vertical size that fits the placement.

faq.q: How much does an AI product video cost?
faq.a: Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter costs $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I make several versions of one product video?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the same product and try different openings, actors, or voices. Compare the versions in your ad account to see what works.

faq.q: Why make product videos with AI?
faq.a: You can make videos in minutes without a shoot, crew, or creator fees. Try different openings and captions for your ads.

faq.q: Can AI make a news-style product video?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a news-style scene, voice, and message. Set the video length and size, then review it before posting.

faq.q: What should I tell the AI video generator?
faq.a: Tell it what you sell, who the video is for, and the main benefit to show. Clear product details help make a better first version.

faq.q: Can I choose the actor, voice, size, and length?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor, voice, video size, and length before you start. The credit cost appears before generation.

reviews.h2: How Shops Use an AI Video Generator
reviews.lead: Each seller starts from one product photo and posts a clip without a shoot that week.
